title: The River Crossing
description: A vulnerability and trust arc. The traveler must cross a river they cannot swim. They must ask for help — the one thing they have never learned to do.

acts.title: The Far Shore
acts.description: Everything the traveler needs is on the other side. The river is deep, cold, and moving fast. They have always crossed alone before.

acts.title: The Ferryman's Question
acts.description: A ferryman appears. The price is not gold — it is an honest answer to one question the traveler has been avoiding.

acts.title: The Other Side
acts.description: On the far shore, the traveler discovers they are not alone. Others crossed the same river, carrying the same fear.
